limits: Synthetic parser test verifies implementation indexing, not real sensor/action clock synchronization.
Geometric roundtrip does not validate learned model accuracy or command semantics.
Official source comparison concerns Push-T, not a native Bridge control policy.

comparison.official: Recorded native 2D agent control target, sample action array; environment controller tracks that absolute target.
comparison.project: Future reached 3D poses from state, relative to observation tool frame; raw action first six dimensions unused; commanded gripper from raw action.
comparison.status: Confirmed semantic difference, not established defect
comparison.control: Do not mix command-vs-reached change with normalization or network changes.

comparison.official: Latest observation is sequence index 1 (two observations); execution selects action indices 1 through 8.
comparison.project: Image at t; pose targets state[t+1:t+17]; gripper commands action[t:t+16].
comparison.status: Implementation indexing verified synthetically; real clock semantics not reverified
comparison.control: Future state index +1 is intentional reached-pose definition, not automatically an off-by-one.

comparison.official: Horizon16, every-step sequence starts, pad_before1,pad_after7; repeats boundary values.
comparison.project: Horizon16, stride4, selected Bridge protocol requires 16 real future states and discards incomplete tails.
comparison.control: Changing padding or stride changes effective sample population; isolate it from labels/scaling.

comparison.official: LinearNormalizer limits per dimension, invert with stored scale/offset; dataset source fits entire replay_buffer data arrays.
comparison.project: Tool-relative xyz divided by0.10m; no fitted axiswise offset/scale; unit xyzw quaternion unchanged.
comparison.status: Confirmed recipe difference; current pose encode/decode inverse passes numerical checks
comparison.control: If testing per-axis normalization, fit only frozen training partition and save/invert its parameters; keep physical labels identical; scaling also changes relative loss weights.

comparison.official: Two RGB history frames plus numerical agent position; no language in Push-T.
comparison.project: Single RGB frame plus language through CLIP/Adapter; tool pose defines labels but is absent from pose context.
comparison.status: Confirmed input-contract difference; reserved for condition-module comparison
comparison.control: Do not add proprioception/history during normalization-only comparison.

comparison.official: Image /255 then normalizer to[-1,1],96x96 with encoder crop84.
comparison.status: Backbone-specific difference, not erroneous by default
comparison.control: Keep CLIP preprocessing when keeping CLIP; copying[-1,1] would change encoder input contract.

next_control_candidate: axiswise xyz normalization only after frozen-training range audit; no quaternion rescaling or temporal/action-semantic changes
